name: Smooth Egg Salad on Brioche
whyItWorks: Pure protein and fat, zero plant fiber, dissolves effortlessly in the stomach.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mash 2 hard-boiled eggs fine with 1 tbsp mayo, 1/2 tsp smooth yellow or Dijon mustard (no whole seeds), salt, and paprika. Serve on potato bread, brioche, or sweet Hawaiian rolls.
